json_ld.description:
AirFly Drive expands the AirFly family, bringing wireless audio freedom to your CarPlay or Android Auto-enabled vehicle. Plug in, pair once, and your iPhone or Android device connects wirelessly to your car seconds after you start your vehicle. AirFly Drive removes the need to find your cable and plug in every time you get into your vehicle, making driving more seamless. Access your favorite music, podcasts, maps for navigation, and more – all while your phone stays in your bag. 




Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto on the car's built-in display.  


Plug-and-play setup with no app, account, or charging required.  


Fast automatic reconnection every time the car starts.  


One-press switching between two paired phones.  


Compact aluminum housing designed to stay plugged in.  

USB-A and USB-C support, with a USB-A to USB-C adapter included.
Works with the car's existing display, buttons, and steering-wheel controls.
json_ld.name: Airfly Drive (White)
